run_apply_pca: run the apply_pca script to transform wav2vec features using a PCA matrix and save results
run_pca_transform_batched: run batched PCA transformation on numpy feature arrays using GPU-accelerated matrix multiplication
run_pca_with_unfiltered: run the apply_pca script with the unfiltered flag to process unfiltered feature data
run_pca_copy_metadata: run the apply_pca script which copies tsv, lengths, phn, and wrd metadata files to the output directory
run_pca_append_array: run the apply_pca script that appends transformed feature batches to an NpyAppendArray output file
